descriptions.w3d_set_vector_mode_8026d8e8: Initializes the object through 0x8026dbe8 if word +0x4c is zero, then passes a copied three-float vector to 0x8026d524. Mode one uses constant 0x803cbd74 for all axes; other modes use 0x803cbd78 for x and 0x803cbd74 for y/z. Inferred names, observed copy construction and call order.
